correctness.rationale: For each finite absorbing walk the exact mixed Green-kernel covariance identity in the proof follows from the ordered occupation-pair decomposition. The Green entries solve the killed birth–death difference equation and give a linear-in-barrier covariance scale under the specified exponential weak-drift law. A bounded Green-kernel Riemann sum establishes the displayed explicit limiting covariance function for every fixed starting site and positive scaled drift; the symmetric Green kernel separately covers zero drift. The second-derivative identity for the explicit numerator proves strict negativity at starting sites three or farther, while the hyperbolic-sine identity proves positivity at site one. Monotonicity of the exponential stop-loss ratio gives a unique zero at starting site two. Independent exact-rational recurrence checks and large-m numeric tests replay successfully from the bundled code. No finite simulation is relied upon for infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: Absorption time measures total residence before ruin, whereas local time at the boundary-adjacent site measures repeated exposure to near-ruin. Their dependence is not determined by their marginal means. The exact weak-drift phase diagram detects an unexpected discrete change with starting position: positive at 1, drift-reversing at 2, negative at 3 and beyond. The unique threshold is a natural dimensionless crossover for barrier problems, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a small numerical increment. It supplies a sharp benchmark and reveals information invisible from mean hitting times or marginal visit distributions.
